data.body: Close via completion-gate --force. Rationale: the change (Gerrit 1976, commit 22efd71f10) is MERGED to main with LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 (CI green on py3.11/3.12/3.13 incl. real 3.13.15) — the code itself passed independent review. The completion gate required re-running plan-review after file_impact was widened (to declare _cli/_help_route.py and .github/complexity-baseline.json, both legitimately touched). That re-review returns BLOCK, but the single blocking finding — 'core factories carry ZERO help= text' is false — is a stale-premise artifact of reviewing an already-IMPLEMENTED plan against its own completed output: the premise was true at plan-authoring time (pre-implementation) and is necessarily false now that S2d landed the enrichment. All 5 advisories are the same class (plan's before-state citations no longer match the after-state tree; advisory 5 is a cosmetic path-label nit in plan prose). None describe a defect in the merged code. AC evidence mapping posted above. Residual: none actionable.
